reason: I might download the free version for the doctor PDF, since my period is six weeks late and I need something to show a clinician, but I'm not paying to have my log sent to an AI. On $31k, five bucks a month for a chatbot and breathing exercises isn't a priority.
objection: The whole point is that my data stays on my phone, and then Pro's main feature sends it off to an AI. 'You see what is sent first' sounds nice, but I deleted my last period app for a reason and I'd want to read the policy on who processes it and whether it's kept. I'd also be checking whether the 'cravings' and 'movement' logging turns into weight-loss nudging.
would_change_my_mind: An independent privacy audit or a clear published policy saying the AI provider keeps and trains on nothing, plus a few months of using the free app without any weight-loss pushing.
